card.name: Words that steer away from body sites
card.fires_on: Negation or avoidance words and the linking words after them, in instructions about where not to inject or apply a drug, such as "Do not", "without", "avoiding", and "or" in lists of skin areas to skip.

modes.label: Avoid/not directly
modes.description: A negation or avoidance word that begins a warning about where or how to give the drug.
modes.example: Do<< not>> administer into muscle or blood vessel.

modes.label: Linking word in avoided-site list
modes.description: A comma, "or", "other" or "a" inside a list of places to avoid, such as eyes, scars or vessels.
modes.example: Avoid contact with eyes or<< other>> mucous membranes.

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted staring and gazing words; the effect is mostly a weak suppression of unrelated tokens.
